method: Use original canonical current f65 and final f8 ELFs; neither is rebuilt for this comparison.
Per-call getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) counts only measured exec intervals. Caller CPU is separate. Reset, complete validation, silent repeat and warmup are excluded.
Dependency process clocks cover only immediate exec intervals. Full envelope CPU, including warmup and repeats, is retained separately without a per-operation denominator.

ABBA sequence pairs first current with first candidate and second current with second candidate. Rows report medians and ranges of two window statistics; these are descriptive, not significance tests.
p99 is a finite 100-sample window order statistic. Microsecond encoding and clock resolution are not accuracy claims.
limitations: Oracle timing does not replace the four-side AX3000T measurements and is not appended as a fifth router side.
This comparison isolates the final round from the latest UCI canonical starting artifact. Do not add or splice previously reported UCI or SDK percentage gains.
Old and final are different canonical builds as well as source variants; this does not separately quantify compiler-layout versus source effects.
No syscall instrumentation or wait4/ptrace resource probe ran in these windows. Resource claims remain in the separately collected router matrix.
Baseline sync_all and atomic rename run on private tmpfs; these results do not predict flash persistence. service.event acceptance does not prove downstream reload completion.
